responsibility: Implements C-family front-end instrumentation helpers for UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer. It builds tree-level checks and runtime calls for division errors, invalid shifts, bounds violations, null/alignment/reference/member-call misuse, and related undefined-behavior cases, deciding when instrumentation can be elided and wrapping affected expressions so later lowering emits the appropriate IFN or __ubsan runtime operations.
same_name_distinction: Implementation of C-family UBSan instrumentation: unlike c-ubsan.h, which only declares the instrumentation entry points, this file builds the tree-level checks and sanitizer runtime/IFN calls for divisions, shifts, bounds, references, and member calls.
